aim: The gold funds' block, this week's zone: among the individuals in the gold funds, sellers' average ticket is unusually large against buyers' (the lowest 40% of the past year). On the record such weeks were followed by a weaker week. The reader can check both chances a week later against the same figure in that night's message. 'Close lower' means tgju-level 18K a week later is below tonight's price; 'drop to' means a night's figure reached that price within the week.
text: Big holders among them are selling this week. Next trade week vs tonight's 25.16M: 46% to close lower (typical 38%); 25% to drop to 24.49M (−2.7%).

aim: The same block, another zone: sellers' tickets are not unusually large against buyers' this week (the 40%-80% band of the past year). On the record such weeks were followed by the strongest next week. It does not say big holders are buying, only that they are not the ones selling.
text: Buyers lead this week: big holders among them are not selling. Next trade week vs tonight's 25.16M: 29% to close lower (typical 38%); 30% to rise to 26.34M (+4.7%).

aim: The same block, the third zone: buyers' average ticket is unusually large against sellers' (the top 20% of the past year), a rush of large buyers. On the record such weeks were followed by a weaker week than the middle zone.
text: Big buyers crowded in this week. Next trade week vs tonight's 25.16M: 42% to close lower (typical 38%); 23% to drop to 24.49M (−2.7%).
